title: CHAPTER SEVEN. On the means of salvation; Word as law or Gospel
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): On ye means belonging toward human salvation, and namely on ye law. — CHAPTER SEVEN. — These stand as partly external, by which eternal salvation stands as opened and offered toward us by God, and partly internal, by which it stands as conferred on us by ye same God and apprehended by us. — now we will treat ye means by which one arrives at it. — Thus far we have seen ye principles belonging toward salvation on which it depends; — Ye whole word belonging toward God stands as now contained in ye books belonging toward ye Old and New Testaments. — And it stands as law or Gospel. — IV. — Ye WORD belonging toward God stands as ye external means belonging toward salvation by which God indicates His will toward humans, so that they may know what He wills toward be done by them and how He stands as affected toward them. — III. — ye word, ye sacraments, and ye ministry. — Ye external means stand as: — II.
pass_b_english: CHAPTER SEVEN. On the means of human salvation, and namely on the law.

Thus far we have seen the principles of salvation on which it depends; now we will treat the means by which one arrives at it. These are partly external, by which eternal salvation is opened and offered to us by God, and partly internal, by which it is conferred on us by the same God and apprehended by us.

II. The external means are: the word, the sacraments, and the ministry. III. The WORD of God is the external means of salvation by which God indicates His will to humans, so that they may know what He wills to be done by them and how He is affected toward them. IV. And it is law or Gospel. The whole word of God is now contained in the books of the Old and New Testaments.
source_text: CAPUT SEPTIMUM, De mediis salutis humanae, & quidem nominatim de lege. Hactenus vidimus de principiis salutis, e quibus ea dependet; nunc agemus de mediis, quibus ad eam pervenitur, eaque sunt alia externa, quibus a Deo salus aeterna nobis patefit et offertur, aliud internum, quo illa ab eodem nobis confertur & a nobis apprehenditur. II. Externa sunt: verbum, sacramenta & ministerium. III. VERBUM Dei est externum salutis medium, quo Deus hominibus voluntatem suam indicat, ut cognoscant quid ab ipsis fieri velit, & quomodo erga eos affectus sit. IV. Estque lex aut Evangelium. Totum Dei verbum libris V. & N.T. nunc continetur.
